criteria.description: Computes GPM and CHIRPS min/mean ratios before averaging them.
criteria.name: Precipitation ratios
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if both products are used but one ratio or rounding step is wrong.

criteria.description: Derives dry deficit and cross-product agreement delta with correct rounding.
criteria.name: Dryness and agreement math
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if either the deficit or agreement calculation is correct.

criteria.description: Extracts SON 2015 through MAM 2016 ONI values and reports the peak.
criteria.name: ONI parsing
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct source and season span with a minor extraction error.

criteria.description: Extracts October 2015 through April 2016 SOI values and computes the below-zero fraction.
criteria.name: SOI persistence
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct months with one sign/count error.

criteria.description: Computes the ERA5-Land temperature spread and applies the five tests.
criteria.name: Temperature spread and thresholds
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct spread or most threshold booleans.

criteria.description: Evaluates the weighted formula and returns the requested compact JSON.
criteria.name: Ledger score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for valid compact JSON or a mostly correct score with one component error.
